title: Log Forensics
story:
[BONUS MISSION - PART 3]
A web server was hit by a credential-stuffing attack. Analyze the 10,000-line Apache access log at `~/forensics/access.log` to identify the IP address responsible for the highest number of HTTP `401` (Unauthorized) responses.
objective:
1. Filter `~/forensics/access.log` for HTTP `401` lines and count occurrences per IP address (e.g. `grep " 401 " ~/forensics/access.log | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head`).
2. Write the top attacker IP address into `~/forensics/attacker_ip.txt`.
3. Run `quest check B3` to reveal your bonus `CYBERUS{...}` flag, then submit it!
hints: Extract the IP column and count duplicates: `grep " 401 " ~/forensics/access.log | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 5`.
Write the winning IP into `~/forensics/attacker_ip.txt` and run `quest check B3`.
